subject: math

hotspots.label: Hundreds place
hotspots.description: The hundreds place holds digits worth hundreds — a 5 here means 500.
hotspots.positionHint: A column of hundred-blocks (10 by 10 slabs) on the right side of the model.
hotspots.function: Holds the hundreds digit, each worth 100.

hotspots.label: Tens place
hotspots.description: The tens place holds digits worth tens — a digit 3 here means 30.
hotspots.positionHint: A column of ten-sticks in the center of the model.
hotspots.function: Holds the tens digit, each worth 10.

hotspots.label: Ones place
hotspots.description: The ones place holds single units. When ten ones collect, they regroup into one ten.
hotspots.positionHint: A column of single cubes on the right side of the model.
hotspots.function: Holds the ones digit, each worth 1.

hotspots.label: Digit labels
hotspots.description: The written digit under each column ties the blocks to the number they represent.
hotspots.positionHint: Flat label plates beneath each column showing the number's digits (e.g. 573).
hotspots.function: Links the concrete blocks to the abstract written number.

visualStyleNotes: Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. Three vertical columns of clean base-ten blocks (hundreds flat blocks, tens rods, ones cubes) sit on a calm surface, lit with soft neutral studio light — no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color is reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (coral / molecular-green / amber / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered. Calm, minimal chrome, labels as flat plates.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Hundred-blocks: soft warm amber (roughness ~0.5) with faint inset grid lines. Ten-rods: soft violet (roughness ~0.5). Ones cubes: warm off-white (roughness ~0.55). Base shadow plane: very soft warm grey (roughness ~0.9). Digit label plates: warm paper white with ink text. No emissive channels anywhere — interaction highlights are handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: base-ten place value as three groups of clean blocks — one for hundreds (a 10×(ten) is 10 by 10 = 100 surface), one for tens (10 joined rods), one for ones (10 single cubes) arranged along the x-axis and sharing a smooth matte surface, with a digit plate beneath each column (settling on 5 hundreds, 7 tens, 3 ones = 573).

GEOMETRY: hundreds = a 10×10 grid of unit cubes (radius 0.03 cubes) around x=0.9; tens = ten unit rods arranged at x=0; ones = 10 unit cubes at x=−0.9. Regrouping layer: a loose group named Regroupables = ten single cubes that a tap animates into a single ten-rod (app-driven tween) to show 10 ones → 1 ten. Digit plates lined under each column.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) show/hide block groups; (2) digit label plates; (3) regroup animation set.

CAMERA: head-on from +z fits all three columns; labels legible. Budget 8-15k triangles. Named nodes: HundredsGrid, TensRods, OnesCubes, Regroupables, DigitPlate_Each, Pop_Label. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
